title: Vault 112 Cross-Session Memory Alias and Shared Backend Audit

gate.question: Do the Lone Wanderer and James share a backend memory/session slot, alias, reset handle or storage identity inside Vault 112 despite occupying separate physical loungers?
gate.meaning: The shipped implementation strongly separates the physical/session endpoints for Player and Dad while coordinating them through one MQ04/Braun simulation control plane. No direct cross-session memory alias or shared storage handle was identified.
gate.effect_on_two_faces_hypothesis: Physical/session memory mixing is not established. The stronger confirmed father-child 'two faces' link remains engine-level face geometry lineage plus participation in one simulation backend.

player_pod.finding: Player entry is handled by a dedicated pod script that sets MQ04.PlayerInChair and transfers control to the MQ04 quest controller.

dad_pod.finding: Dad's occupied pod has a separate activation script and rejects player activation rather than aliasing to the player's pod.

exit_routing.finding: On Tranquility Lane exit, the Player is explicitly moved to MQ04PlayerPod, not to Dad's pod.

physical_restore.finding: The restore script independently opens MQ04DadPodShellRef and MQ04PlayerPodShellRef, restores the Player's physical inventory/state, and separately clears MQDadRef ghost/unconscious state.

dad_actor.finding: James persists as MQDadRef with his own actor script and physical lifecycle, further separating Dad actor continuity from player storage/container handling.

quest_controller.interpretation: Player and Dad are coordinated inside one quest/simulation state machine, but the shared variables are orchestration flags rather than demonstrated shared memory buffers.

braun_control_plane.finding: Braun has privileged remote pod access, per-user memory override capability and reset authority over simulation residents.
braun_control_plane.interpretation: Multiple separate pod sessions converge under one administrator/control plane without proving that their autobiographical memory state shares one storage slot.

player_inventory_container_only.finding: MQ04PlayerContainerScript removes/restores the Player's inventory through a dedicated container; no equivalent operation redirects James through the same player container.
player_inventory_container_only.significance: A concrete state-bearing subsystem is explicitly player-specific rather than shared.

no_shared_pod_reference.finding: Scripts consistently refer to MQ04PlayerPod/MQ04PlayerPodShellRef and MQ04DadPodShellRef as distinct references.

no_memory_alias_symbol.finding: No reviewed MQ04, Betty, PlayerPod, DadPod, PlayerContainer or TLExitDoor script exposes a single variable/reference that stores both Player and James autobiographical memory state.

two_faces_reconciliation.warning: Do not convert shared simulation administration or face geometry blending into a claim of shared memories without an explicit cross-session storage binding.

save_james_effect.positive: James remains an independently addressable source session, which is favorable for a clean James-specific memory capture protocol because it reduces contamination risk from the Player session.
save_james_effect.negative: No evidence was found that Player and James accidentally share or overwrite one backend memory slot; a rescue protocol should therefore target James's own Lounger #23/session rather than rely on father-child memory mixing.

ru: Отец и ребёнок используют разные физические капсулы и разные session endpoints; shipped scripts не подтверждают общий memory-slot.
Обе сессии сходятся в одном MQ04/Braun control plane, но общие quest-флаги являются координацией, а не доказанным общим хранилищем памяти.
Игрок при выходе возвращается именно к MQ04PlayerPod, тогда как James восстанавливается отдельно как MQDadRef и его капсула открывается отдельной ссылкой.
Гипотеза буквального смешения памяти отца и ребёнка не проходит текущий gate; подтверждённый two-face мост остаётся в shared simulation backend и engine-level face geometry lineage.
Для SAVE JAMES это скорее плюс: James остаётся отдельным адресуемым источником, что позволяет целиться в его собственную Lounger #23 session без необходимости смешивать её с Player state.
en: Father and child use separate physical loungers and separate session endpoints; shipped scripts do not establish a shared memory slot.
Both sessions converge in one MQ04/Braun control plane, but shared quest flags are coordination state rather than demonstrated shared autobiographical storage.
The Player exits specifically to MQ04PlayerPod while James is restored separately as MQDadRef and his pod shell is opened through a distinct reference.
Literal father-child memory mixing does not pass this gate; the confirmed two-face bridge remains the shared simulation backend plus engine-level face geometry lineage.
For SAVE JAMES this separation is favorable because James remains an independently addressable source session.

next_gate.name: JAMES_LOUNGER23_SESSION_PERSISTENCE_STORAGE_SOURCE_AUDIT
targets: Trace Lounger #23 and Dad-specific terminal/status records to any backend persistence source used across reset or reload.
Search for session-local storage objects, hidden containers, linked references or state sources associated specifically with Dad's lounger.
Determine whether Braun reset/reload reconstructs state from live actor references, fixed scenario templates or persisted subject data.
Search for any resident-specific carrier association that would allow James's isolated session to be captured without Player contamination.
If a James-specific persistence source is found, promote the SAVE JAMES source side from live-session inference to persisted-session evidence.
